title: Flaky CI timeout: hpLifecycle 'uses full damage for instant death at 0 HP across stable/dying and temp buffers' exceeds 5s
description: On 2026-11-01, CI build-test on docs-only PR #704 (run 41314408649) failed: packages/core/test/hpLifecycle.test.ts > adjustHp — temporary hit points > 'uses full damage for instant death at 0 HP across stable/dying and temp buffers' took 5172ms against the 5000ms default timeout. The same test passes locally in verify:worktree. Measure the test's cost. Then either reduce its enumeration, if it is a combinatorial sweep, or give it a justified per-test timeout. Do not weaken its assertions.
notes: Captain: measured the sweep at 1.87s alone; failed CI on #704, #713, #716 and twice on #719. Targeted 20s per-test timeout, PR https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/720.
close_reason: Merged PR #720 (7b6ed056cfc9a6dc852a5568c32ee11e05c786e0) after clean Sol review kcb0.1
